subject.title: Markdown table columns misaligned with CJK characters on Telegram and Discord

question: Should maintainers port the open linked PR to the current markdown-core renderer, replace it with a fresh narrow PR, or close that PR and leave this issue for a new contributor?
rationale: The bug is still present, but the open implementation candidate is conflicting and targets obsolete files, so a human should choose whether to salvage that branch or prefer a clean replacement.

options.title: Replace with current-main PR
options.body: Open or request a narrow replacement against `packages/markdown-core` and the current Telegram/Discord delivery paths, preserving this issue as the canonical tracker.

options.title: Port the linked PR
options.body: Ask the linked PR author to rebase and move the fix into the current shared renderer with focused channel tests and refreshed proof.

options.title: Close the linked PR only
options.body: Close the stale implementation candidate and keep this issue open for a future contributor or repair lane once no open PR owns it.

recommendation.title: Replace with current-main PR
recommendation.body: Open or request a narrow replacement against `packages/markdown-core` and the current Telegram/Discord delivery paths, preserving this issue as the canonical tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original table-mode PR and appears in the recent history carrying the active renderer path, making him the best available routing owner for the branch-vs-replacement choice.
